Description
An example that a single room and twelve actors can produce one of the greatest cinematic masterpieces in history.

David Fincher's stylish and aggressive take on the effects of toxic masculinity mixed with a strong flavour of psychological instability. DO NOT SPOIL THIS MOVIE FOR YOURSELF. GO IN AS BLIND AS POSSIBLE.
One of the darkest and most relentless crime thrillers ever made.
De Niro's most psychologically unsettling performance, in one of Scorsese's defining films of his career.
Brutal, beautifully filmed, and yet genuinely disturbing. Go in blind.
Robin Williams at his absolute best.
With a perfect 100 score on Metacritic, this is the definitive crime epic.
A rare sequel that somehow rivals the original.
An emotional prison drama that definitely earns its reputation.
Possibly De Niro’s most physically and psychologically committed performance.
Robin Williams’ second-best performance. Restrained, sincere and devastating.
Funny, emotional and ridiculously easy to watch. A complete modern classic.
The perfect combination of science fiction, horror and claustrophobic tension.
My favourite Tarantino film. Tense, dynamic and completely unpredictable.
Bong Joon-ho’s second-best film. A dark, funny and deeply unsettling murder mystery.

Martin Scorsese's only personal Oscar Winner for best director. Easily his best modern crime film reinforced with an incredible cast.

My second-favourite Tarantino film, and probably his most purely entertaining.
Chaotic and unexpectedly emotional. I'd be surprised if there was another film like it.
Joaquin Phoenix's unsettling performance that earned his Best Actor win. Only joker performance to come close to Heath Ledger.
Beautiful film.
Come on dude...

One of the most intense films ever made about ambition and obsession.
